company.shortDescription: BioRender develops a science visualization platform for the pharmaceutical and life sciences industries.
company.description: BioRender develops a science visualization platform for the pharmaceutical and life sciences industries. Its tool helps scientists create and share professional scientific figures. It represents science with intuitive visuals that can be understood by everyone. It uses standard visual language for science, so communication is seamless.
